title: 第六十四章 凛冬龙魂第六十三章 目标不朽级满评分
content_zh:
这份被动能力，来源于王长乐从星海时空『圣灵级宝箱』的意外收获。
原本王长乐不达到8阶，没使用可能，可他现在有了『称号?破界者』。
这称号能力若是在战斗中使用，能提供的战斗增益，未必能比得上『孩子王』或『唯一称号?太阳神』。
可在属性壁障突破方面，有奇效。
“嗡”
【提示：猎杀者已开启『限制突破』，你可临时突破属性壁垒阶位限制，但无法获得特质奖励。】
【检测到猎杀者已选择真实体力作为指定属性，你的真实体力已临时突破200点属性壁障，持续时间5分钟。】
【你已受到‘太阳奇迹?恩赐’增益影响，全?真实属性提升4点，持续1小时。】
……
【你已受到‘太阳奇迹?征服’影响，气息强度判定值5，真实体力临时2，真实力量临时2，持续30分钟】
……
完成称号切换的同时，王长乐手中就出现了数枚『旭日之阳』卷轴，下一秒，卷轴尽数破碎。
当数轮柔光虚影在他脑后，化作层叠的日晕时，王长乐能清晰地感知到，在各项增益状态加持下，他达标了。
【提示：猎杀者已学会了模板专长?传奇固定伤害减免，当前LV.1。】
【检测到猎杀者的『专长?低级伤害免疫』已达到LV.mAx
，正在判定中……】
【判定完成，『模板专长?传奇固定伤害减免』与『专长：低级伤害免疫』已从技能列表除。】
【猎杀者学会了新的模板专长：传奇固定伤害免疫，当前等级LV.32，请注意查看。】
模板专长?传奇固定伤害免疫，被动技能，当前等级LV.32：
技能效果1：免疫任何低于真实肉体强度160点的伤害，此效果对任意伤害均有效，包括真实伤害、灵魂伤害和斩杀伤害。

提示：因此效果仅在伤害结算后，予以生效，故可无视阶位判定，当前最大可免疫322点伤害。
技能效果2，坚硬（特性）:猎杀者在受到攻击时，你的躯体角质层和血肉将迅速硬化，身体防御力将临时10%。
提示：当前猎杀者的身体防御力，临时增幅综合值为835%，即将达到阶位极限850%。
……
在点点幽光入体的间隙，王长乐能感知到到在他体内的某些，固定的能量回路，出现了细微的变化。
查看完属性信息后，他扯出抹笑。
【模板专长：传奇固定伤害免疫】的技能效果，看上去并不算强。
300多点的伤害免疫，在面对9阶存在时，甚至很难产生实质性的作用。
这能力的关键不在于，伤害免疫。
在于无视阶位判定，且生效时间是在完成伤害结算之后，这一点和王长乐的其他能力都不同。
如果进行伤害模拟，大概流程如下
遭受攻击→护盾护体能量→身体防御力外部装甲防御基础防御阶位→肉体强度元素抗性→刚韧之躯生灵的庇护→进行伤害结算→传奇固定伤害免疫→承受伤害→反噬铭文基座?星辰
在如此层层减免下，相当于为王长乐又套了层甲，原本能破防的不朽级武器，现在都未必能对他造成伤害。
关键这项能力还将根据，王长乐的肉体强度的提升，获得相应的强化。
“哗”
思及此处，王长乐当即就将『太阳秘技?焚骨』和『卷轴：光合作用』全取了出来，选择使用。
下一秒，只见在金灿色暖阳柔光中，一缕太阳之焰焰光陡然暴涨，瞬时化作炙炎流光，没入他的体内。
王长乐的确拥有高额的灼焰抗性，可无视太阳之焰带来的伤害，但那顺着经络深入骨髓的焚烧，却未曾断绝。
content_en:
This passive ability comes from Wang Changle's unexpected harvest from the "Holy Spirit Level Treasure Box" in the Star Sea Spacetime.
Originally, Wang Changle had not reached level 8 and could not use it, but now he has the "title? Boundary Breaker".
If this title ability is used in battle, the combat benefits it can provide may not be comparable to "King of Children" or "The Only Title? Sun God".
It can be miraculous in breaking through attribute barriers.
"Buzz"
[Tip: Hunter has turned on "Restriction Breakthrough". You can temporarily break through the attribute barrier level restrictions, but you will not be able to obtain trait rewards. 】
[It has been detected that the hunter has selected real physical strength as the designated attribute. Your real physical strength has temporarily broken through the 200 attribute barrier for 5 minutes. 】
[You have been affected by the ‘Miracle Gift of the Sun’ benefit, and all real attributes are increased by 4 points, lasting for 1 hour. 】
…
[You have been affected by the ‘Miracles of the Sun? Conquer’, the aura strength judgment value is 5, the real physical strength is temporarily 2, the real strength is temporarily 2, lasting for 30 minutes]
…
At the same time as the title switch was completed, several "Rising Sun" scrolls appeared in Wang Changle's hand. The next second, all the scrolls were shattered.
When several rounds of soft light shadows turned into cascading halos behind his head, Wang Changle could clearly feel that with the blessing of various buffs, he had reached the target.
[Tip: Hunter has learned the template expertise? Legendary fixed damage reduction, current LV.1. 】
[It has been detected that the hunter's "Specialty? Low-level damage immunity" has reached LV.mAx
, being judged...]
[Judgment completed, "Template Specialty? Legendary Fixed Damage Reduction" and "Specialty: Low-Level Damage Immunity" have been removed from the skill list. 】
[Hunter has learned a new template specialty: legendary fixed damage immunity, the current level is LV.32, please check it carefully. 】
Template expertise? Legendary fixed damage immunity, passive skills, current level LV.32:
Skill Effect 1: Immune to any damage lower than 160 points of true physical strength. This effect is valid for any damage, including true damage, soul damage and beheading damage.
Tip: Therefore, the effect will only take effect after the damage is settled, so the level determination can be ignored. The current maximum immunity is 322 points of damage.
Skill Effect 2, Hardness (Characteristic): When a hunter is attacked, your body's cuticles and flesh will harden rapidly, and your body's defense will be temporarily 10%.
Tip: The current physical defense of the hunter has a temporary comprehensive increase value of 835%, which is about to reach the tier limit of 850%.
…
In the gaps between bits of dim light entering his body, Wang Changle could sense subtle changes in certain fixed energy circuits in his body.
After checking the attribute information, he smiled.
The skill effect of [Template Specialty: Legendary Fixed Damage Immunity] does not look very strong.
With more than 300 points of damage immunity, it is difficult to even have a substantial effect when facing a ninth-level existence.
The key to this ability is not damage immunity.
It ignores rank determination and takes effect after the damage is settled. This is different from Wang Changle's other abilities.
If damage simulation is performed, the approximate process is as follows
Under attack → Shield and body protection energy → Body defense, external armor defense, basic defense level → Physical strength, elemental resistance → Protection of tough creatures → Perform damage settlement → Legendary fixed damage immunity → Take damage → Backlash inscription base? Stars
Under such layers of reduction, it is equivalent to putting on another layer of armor for Wang Changle. Immortal-level weapons that could originally break through defense may not be able to cause harm to him now.
This key ability will also be strengthened accordingly as Wang Changle's physical strength increases.
"Wow"
Thinking of this, Wang Changle immediately took out the "Secret Technique of the Sun: Burning Bones" and "Scroll: Photosynthesis" and chose to use.
The next second, in the golden warm soft light of the sun, a ray of sun's flame suddenly surged and instantly turned into a scorching stream of light, sinking into his body.
Wang Changle did have a high level of flame resistance and could ignore the damage caused by the sun's flames, but the burning that penetrated into the bone marrow along his meridians was never cut off.
